method: Sum the repository-relative files listed for each route. Baseline files are read from baseline_commit; current files are read from the working tree. Each route includes the root and nearest AGENTS.md plus only the explicitly loaded project skill and reference.

routes.name: asset-generation
routes.regression_rationale: The prior short crate context omitted canonical generation commands, no-write check behavior, serialized level boundaries, and deterministic comparison gates; the added detail is loaded only for asset work.

routes.name: level-generation-primary
routes.regression_rationale: The primary level-generation route now includes exact generation, serialization, benchmark, and deterministic asset gates that the prior crate context did not preserve.

routes.name: level-generation-with-worldgen
routes.regression_rationale: This optional deep route intentionally loads both complete references for changes spanning serialization and generation policy; ordinary level output work uses the smaller primary route.
